subject: Carelane pilot: request to extend pilot window while vendor onboarding completes
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@carelane.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 16:23:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot hold — procurement onboarding delaying PO clearance

Hi Rishi,

Quick update from our procurement team — the supplier onboarding team found a required vendor questionnaire discrepancy and put a hard stop on PO issuance until the vendor docs are re-submitted. That means our signed PO (we expected it today) is now likely pushed out by ~7–10 business days.

We’re in the middle of a small pilot and the team is near a key demo next week; if the environment times out we’ll lose momentum. Is there any way Redwood can extend the pilot window or provide a short interim credit so we can keep the trial running while procurement finishes the onboarding?

I attached the interim paperwork (PO draft and the questionnaire they flagged). Happy to jump on a quick call if easier.

Thanks,
Samira Khan
Senior Product Manager – Carelane Health
samira.khan@carelane.com
Attachment: carelane_po_pending.pdf (pdf, 42KB)
Attachment: carelane-sow-v1.pdf (pdf, 120KB)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@carelane.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot hold — procurement onboarding delaying PO clearance

Hi Samira — thanks for the heads up and for attaching the docs.

Kimberly / Marissa — looping you in. Carelane’s PO is in-flight but supplier onboarding has held it; Samira is requesting either a short pilot extension or temporary credits to keep their test environment live while procurement completes the onboarding (expect ~7–10 business days).

Key ask from customer: keep the pilot accessible for product team now (demo next Wed) to avoid losing momentum.

Proposed internal options:
- Option A: 7-day extension of the pilot window on their account (no extra credits)
- Option B: Provide a one-time interim credit (we usually do X tokens or $ amount for cases like this) and require PO once onboarding is complete

Samira — if you can confirm which you prefer (extension vs credit) and that the PO will be completed once onboarding is cleared, I’ll route for quick approval.

Rishi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot hold — procurement onboarding delaying PO clearance

Thanks for the context. We get these fairly often with healthcare customers. A couple of notes from finance/ops:

- We can approve a short, time-boxed extension of 7 calendar days on the pilot without additional credits.
- Alternatively, we can issue a one-time $500 credit (applies towards usage) as a goodwill interim — requires an email confirmation from the customer that PO is in process and an expectation date.
- If they want more than 7 days or higher credit, we escalate to Marissa for exception.

Rishi — what’s Carelane leaning toward? Also please attach the HubSpot deal link and the PO draft so we can record the decision.

Kimberly
Revenue Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@carelane.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot hold — procurement onboarding delaying PO clearance

Samira — quick follow. Kimberly confirmed two feasible paths (see below). Which would you prefer?

- 7-day trial window extension (no credit)
- One-time $500 interim credit (applies to usage) — need your email confirmation that PO is being processed and expected clear date

If you confirm the credit route, I’ll issue it right away and attach an internal approval record. Otherwise I’ll extend the pilot for 7 days and note the PO is expected.

Also attaching the HubSpot link for our records: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1937

—Rishi

Cc: Alex Ortega <alex.ortega@carelane.com>
Date: Sun, 4 Oct 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot hold — procurement onboarding delaying PO clearance

Hi Rishi — thanks for moving fast on this. We’ll take the one-time $500 interim credit, and procurement has given an expected PO clearance date of 2026-10-12 (they confirmed they’ll re-submit the questionnaire by tomorrow).

Please apply the credit and send any internal confirmation we can include in our procurement notes. Also — we’re happy to sign the DocuSign confirmation you mentioned if that helps (link you shared).

Appreciate the help.

Best,
Samira
